acceptance: No `pl.col(...).n_unique()` without a NULL drop remains under `benchbox/core`.
The affected read primitive returns the same rows as before on TPC-H data, and its timing before and after is recorded in this item.
description:
Latent inconsistency. PR #4169 made `UnifiedExpr.n_unique()` skip NULL on Polars so it equals SQL `COUNT(DISTINCT x)`. `benchbox/core/read_primitives/dataframe_queries.py` (around line 2317, the Polars-native cube/rollup path) calls `pl.col("o_custkey").n_unique()` on the native frame and so still counts NULL. TPC-H `o_custkey` has no NULLs, so no answer is wrong today; the call would diverge from the other platforms on any data with NULL keys.

Expected: that call drops NULL first, or goes through the unified expression.

Guardrails: this is a timed read primitive; record before and after timing for the affected primitive on Polars and keep the change only if it is not more than 10% slower.
